title: DATE-LM: Benchmarking Data Attribution Evaluation for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Applying data attribution methods to score and filter unsafe or toxic training examples (using datasets like ToxicChat, XSTest, and JailbreakBench), and evaluating the effectiveness of this filtering by measuring the retrained model's Attack Success Rate (ASR) on harmful prompts using GPT-4o as an automated judge.
